summary: ITER166 frontend-only test of cinematic post-onboarding Design Journey flow. 11/12 cases PASS. The 401-interceptor fix in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js works as intended: /journey/preparing and /auth/recovery remain stable for >6s with no redirect to /auth/login despite 401s from provider calls. JourneyPreparingPage cinematic copy, personalization (?name=Maria), opaque resend success, and 'Tornare alla landing' link all behave per spec. AuthRecoveryPage renders concierge title, both CTAs ('Invia nuovo accesso' / 'Entra con la tua password') and pre-fills email from ?email=. Backend POST /api/auth/silent-magic-link with admin returns 200 opaque. /begin-journey accessible without session. Smoke on /, /auth/login, /magazine, /projects passes. ONE P2 violation: homepage CTA reads 'Accedi' (twice in DOM, visible top-right) instead of the required editorial copy 'Entra nel tuo spazio'.

ui_bugs.issue: Top-right re-entry CTA renders the banned word 'Accedi' (link). User explicitly requested: 'MAI Accedi o Login. Termini consentiti: Entra nel tuo spazio, Design Journey, Client Profile, Spazio progettuale.' The DOM contains 2 occurrences of the word 'accedi' on / (likely desktop + mobile). Same header is reused on /begin-journey so the violation propagates there too. Replace with 'Entra nel tuo spazio' (or 'Il tuo spazio progettuale').

action_items: Replace 'Accedi' link in the public HomePage header with 'Entra nel tuo spazio' (or equivalent editorial copy). The same header component is rendered on /begin-journey via reuse, so a single fix solves both surfaces.
(carry-over from iter157) Add data-testid='client-welcome-cta-continue' to ClientWelcomePanel.
(carry-over) Address 17 missing it-IT i18n keys flagged by editorial-debug badge on /auth/login.
critical_code_review_comments: api.js public-surface allowlist is a STRING list — adding new public routes requires touching this file. Recommend extracting to a single PUBLIC_SURFACE_PATTERNS array (regex/glob) so future cinematic surfaces (e.g., /journey/welcome/*, /preview/*) opt-in declaratively without scattering startsWith() calls. Current implementation works correctly but is brittle.
JourneyPreparingPage.jsx imports `useNavigate` but never uses it (line 11). Minor lint cleanup.
AuthRecoveryPage.jsx also imports `useNavigate` unused (line 10). Minor lint cleanup.
AuthRecoveryPage.jsx: when sendNew submits with invalid email it silently no-ops (just returns) — consider showing a soft hint to preserve concierge tone instead of dead-click.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (11/12 — homepage CTA copy is the only deviation)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Core ITER166 P0/P1 cinematic flow is solid. The only outstanding deviation is the homepage header copy ('Accedi'). After the main agent swaps the link text to 'Entra nel tuo spazio', a 5-second smoke on / should be enough to validate (look for absence of /accedi|login/i in all visible button/anchor text). Helper assertion: `await page.evaluate(() => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a,button')).map(e => e.textContent.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(t => t === 'accedi' || t === 'login'))` should return [].
rca_of_the_issue: RCA confirmed: the 401-interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js was redirecting visitors out of cinematic surfaces because BlueprintContext / TenantThemeContext make background GETs that return 401 when no session exists. The fix correctly adds /journey/preparing and /preview/* to the public-surface allowlist (lines 105-128 in api.js). Manual reproduction: navigate to /journey/preparing without a session, wait 6.5s — page stays. Before fix, redirect happened ~3.3s after mount. No regression observed on other surfaces (auth login flow still redirects to login as expected when API calls fail on protected routes).
